column1: # definition: Count each executable C# invocation of Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith or IndexOf whose immediate receiver is named Message. Include qualified or bare member access, conditional access, multiline formatting, parentheses and null-forgiving wrappers. Count all overloads. Exclude comments, string contents, inactive preprocessor regions, aliases and transformed receivers.
# Classification: control if any counted call influences state, execution, replay, routing, acceptance, recovery or a hold. Display-only means every counted call affects presentation alone.
# Ceiling: actual counts at or below the recorded count pass. Unused rows are allowed during retirement.
